Title: Public preview: Azure Machine Learning VS Code Integration

Body.Content:
Azure Machine Learning VS Code Integration enables the full power of VS Code connected to your Azure Machine Learning Compute for more sophisticated code editing tasks including:

  • Multi-file editing 
  • Git integration 
  • Full code navigation 
  • Debugging 
  • Remote terminal access 
  • Extension usage (e.g. Azure Machine Learning, Jupyter, Python, Pylance) 

Also enables a seamless connection to VSCode without SSH setup or other remote server configuration.

Learn more.
